ceu: ✦ The opposition between the Sun and Saturn

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
Until {H:1823856384000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up your money and what you value.
The opposition between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between relationships and your image. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Apologise for a careless word, if need be.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
Until {H:1823856384000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.
The opposition between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between routine and your inner life. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Put aside a small amount, just to build the habit.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
Until {H:1823856384000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up rest and your inner life.
The opposition between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between romance and friendships. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Look after your image: a haircut, a new piece of clothing or simply standing up straight.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
Until {H:1823856384000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.
The opposition between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between family and your career. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Forgive yourself for something that is already in the past.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
Until {H:1823856384000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up your career and your goals.
The opposition between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Picture your ideal future for five minutes, in detail.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
Until {H:1823856384000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.
The opposition between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between money and intimacy. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Finish one important task before starting another.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
Until {H:1823856384000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.
The opposition between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between your image and relationships. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Say a prayer or set an intention for your path.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
Until {H:1823856384000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.
The opposition between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between your inner life and routine. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Take a deep breath whenever you feel jealousy or distrust.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
Until {H:1823856384000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.
The opposition between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between friendships and romance. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
Until {H:1823856384000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.
The opposition between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between your career and family. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
Until {H:1823856384000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up home and family.
The opposition between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
Until {H:1823856384000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.
The opposition between the Sun and Saturn creates some tension between intimacy and money. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.
